title: Trace delivery when the happy path breaks
description: Choose a network or cache event and inspect the active route. The result distinguishes data-plane delivery from control-plane changes and shows when stale content can protect the origin.

nodes.label: Viewer
nodes.detail: Resolves the hostname, negotiates a connection, and experiences the complete response path.

nodes.label: Edge location
nodes.detail: Terminates the connection, enforces edge policy, and serves a fresh or permitted stale object when the cache key matches.

nodes.label: Regional shield
nodes.detail: Concentrates edge misses so many locations do not stampede the origin for the same object.

nodes.label: Origin service
nodes.detail: Generates personalized responses or retrieves canonical objects and defines their freshness contract.

nodes.label: Object store
nodes.detail: Holds immutable asset versions and durable source objects behind the origin or directly as a protected origin.

scenarios.label: Warm edge hit
scenarios.summary: A versioned asset has a stable key and remains fresh at the nearby edge.
scenarios.result: The edge answers without origin work. Measure cache status, age, and key dimensions so the hit can be explained rather than inferred from latency alone.

scenarios.label: Cold object at many edges
scenarios.summary: A newly published object is requested across regions before local caches have it.
scenarios.result: A regional shield and request coalescing turn many simultaneous misses into bounded origin fetches. Without them, a popular cold object can become an origin stampede.

scenarios.label: Origin timeout with stale allowed
scenarios.summary: The edge holds an expired object whose policy permits stale delivery during revalidation or an origin error.
scenarios.result: Serve the bounded stale object and revalidate separately. The policy must exclude unsafe personalized or mutation responses from this fallback.

scenarios.label: Cache-key fragmentation
scenarios.summary: An unnecessary header enters the cache key and splits one object into thousands of low-volume variants.
scenarios.result: Normalize the key and retain only representation-changing dimensions. Increasing TTL does not help when requests cannot converge on the same cache entry.

scenarios.label: Regional edge failure
scenarios.summary: Health routing moves viewers away from an impaired edge region while the origin remains healthy.
scenarios.result: Fail traffic to another healthy edge and watch the resulting cold-cache pressure. Edge failover preserves reachability but can still overload shields or origin capacity.
